Macklemore has addressed the backlash he’s faced for his pro-Palestine speech. The singer took to the stage as Ed Sheeran’s opening act at MetLife Stadium on 5 September, where he said “Free Palestine” before performing his 2024 protest song “Hind’s Hall” which condemns Israel’s military campaign in Gaza. He also gave a speech, telling the audience he wanted people in Gaza and the occupied West Bank to know that they had not been forgotten. As a result, the Israeli-American Council launched a petition to Ed Sheeran and his management, urging the musician to remove Macklemore from the remainder of the tour. Artists such as Boy George and P!nk also spoke out, criticizing Macklemore’s comments and calling for Ed Sheeran to address the situation. Posting a video of his speech to his Instagram, Macklemore seemingly addressed the backlash by captioning the post ‘wanting all humans to be treated equal should never be controversial.’ 📷 IG: macklemore #macklemore #edsheeran
